kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنهلك (form VII)
# أَنْهَلِكُ (ʔanhaliku) /ʔan.ha.li.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# أَنْهَلِكَ (ʔanhalika) /ʔan.ha.li.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# أَنْهَلِكْ (ʔanhalik) /ʔan.ha.lik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
